exposure: Antibiotic use during vaginal delivery hospitalization
outcome: Risk for receipt of unindicated antibiotics
cohort: 5,536,756 delivery hospitalizations, including 2,872,286 vaginal deliveries without an indication for antibiotics, from January 2006 to March 2015
finding: The use of antibiotics during vaginal delivery hospitalizations without an indication significantly declined from 2006 to 2015.
